value.0: A ring of flat stones marks a staff circle on the canyon floor, worn smooth by years of footwork. The warden who holds it does not step out of the ring.
A firing line is scratched into the canyon floor, spent power cells scattered behind it. The range warden takes every challenge offered from this mark.
A sabacc table has been dragged into the range, a pistol laid across the last hand ever dealt on it. The warden plays anyone who sits down.
